title: UI icons / Contribution

location.series: IBM Design Language / public web guidelines
location.extent: Complete webpage content area, default interactive state

slide_intent: Make new symbols enter a shared system through deliberate review, because uncontrolled additions can create duplicate meanings and inconsistent rendering.
strategic_value: The submission checklist can protect IBM’s icon vocabulary as more teams contribute.
demonstration: Resource cards precede design criteria, production instructions and a numbered approval process with request links.
practical_value: Prepare a distinct 32px SVG icon with correct pixel alignment and plan for review before publication.

content_islands.name: Resources
content_islands.spec: Place starter-file and library cards below the introduction.

content_islands.name: Design and production
content_islands.spec: Follow with uniqueness, accessibility and international-understanding criteria.

content_islands.name: Production checklist
content_islands.spec: Specify pixel snapping, layer naming, 32px SVG delivery and expanded strokes in the central text column.

content_islands.name: Approval process
content_islands.spec: Conclude with the review stages, timing note and single, batch and update request links.

reference_purposes.Intent: The source explains that contribution guidance maintains visual consistency and proper formatting.
reference_purposes.Application: The checklist describes artboard setup, pixel alignment, stroke expansion and submission.
reference_purposes.Constraint: All submissions require approval; production-ready UI icons are 32×32px SVGs with expanded strokes and full-pixel values.
